name: @bonezegei/bzui
description: bzUI (Bonezegei UI): zero-dependency CSS design tokens, animations and the bzChart.js canvas chart engine for Bonezegei.js apps.
author: Bonezegei

scripts.build: esbuild src/js/bzChart.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/bzChart.min.js && esbuild vendor/Bonezegei.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/Bonezegei.min.js && esbuild src/css/bzui.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-animations.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-animations.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-components.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-components.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-utilities.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-utilities.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-extended.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-extended.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-icons.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-icons.min.css
